hello.title: Hello Python (no gadgets)
hello.help: No CJP required. Prints text and a calculation.
hello.source:
# No hardware needed.
print("Hello, CodyNick!")
temperature = 20 + 5
print("The answer is", temperature)

sim-dashboard.title: Pretend sensor → dashboard and LED
sim-dashboard.help: No CJP required. Adds a simulated temperature sensor. Change its slider in Simulation; view its gauge and graph in Dashboard. Press Stop to finish.
sim-dashboard.source:
from codynick import simulation, dashboard, wait

dashboard.clear()
dashboard.gauge("Temperature", minimum=0, maximum=50)
dashboard.graph("Temperature history")

while True:
    temperature = await simulation.temperature.read()
    dashboard.show("Temperature", temperature)
    dashboard.append("Temperature history", temperature)
    await simulation.led.set_color("green")
    await wait(0.5)

mixed.title: Real temperature → dashboard and pretend LED
mixed.help: Connect a CJP with a real temperature sensor. Open Dashboard for readings. The LED in Simulation becomes red above 30°C and blue otherwise.
mixed.source:
from codynick import hardware, simulation, dashboard, wait

dashboard.clear()
dashboard.gauge("Temperature", minimum=0, maximum=50)
dashboard.graph("Temperature history")

while True:
    temperature = await hardware.temperature.read()
    dashboard.show("Temperature", temperature)
    dashboard.append("Temperature history", temperature)
    color = "red" if temperature > 30 else "blue"
    await simulation.led.set_color(color)
    await wait(0.5)

cross-displays.title: Real and pretend readings → opposite displays
cross-displays.help: Connect CJP, real temperature sensor, and standalone seven-segment display. Adds a simulated ultrasonic sensor and seven-segment display. Real temperature appears on the simulated display; simulated distance on the real display.
cross-displays.source:
from codynick import hardware, simulation, wait

while True:
    temperature = await hardware.temperature.read()
    await simulation.seven_segment.show(round(temperature, 1))
    distance = await simulation.ultrasonic.read()
    await hardware.seven_segment.show(round(distance, 1))
    await wait(0.5)

blink.title: Blink a real CJP light
blink.help: Connect a CJP. Its RGB LED 0 blinks red. Press Stop to finish; Stop leaves the last hardware output unchanged.
blink.source:
from codynick import hardware, wait

while True:
    await hardware.led.set_color("red", index=0)
    await wait(0.5)
    await hardware.led.clear()
    await wait(0.5)

temperature.title: Real temperature → display and dashboard
temperature.help: Connect a CJP, temperature sensor, and standalone seven-segment display. Open Dashboard to see the reading there too.
temperature.source:
from codynick import hardware, dashboard, wait

while True:
    temperature = await hardware.temperature.read()
    await hardware.seven_segment.show(round(temperature, 1))
    dashboard.show("Temperature", temperature)
    await wait(1)

joystick.title: CJP joystick click → real light
joystick.help: Connect a CJP. Press the joystick button to light RGB LED 0 green; release to turn it off.
joystick.source:
from codynick import hardware, wait

while True:
    clicked = await hardware.joystick.clicked()
    await hardware.led.set_color("green" if clicked else "off")
    await wait(0.1)
